Every test in test/blackboard-negative-case-binding.test.mjs is titled with its criterion prefix (NB1..NB4 followed by a space) so each verification run selects exactly its criterion; package.json test:blackboard-jev is extended to run this file so npm run verify and verify:blackboard-context execute it.

architectureDecisions: D1 — Plan field negativeCaseBindings: [{id, negativeCaseIndex, criterionId, verificationId, testRef, testTitle, subjectSymbol}]. Validation (in assertPlan when the field is present): ids unique and safe; every negativeVerificationCases index covered exactly once; criterionId and verificationId exist; the verification's criterion list includes criterionId; testRef is listed in sourceSeams.expectedTests; testTitle and subjectSymbol are non-empty; subjectSymbol matches /^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*$/.

D2 — Enforcement: jev-policy.json gains negativeCaseBindingsFromWorkId (string BB-id or null). When set and Number(task.id.slice(3)) >= threshold, a plan with non-empty negativeVerificationCases must declare negativeCaseBindings or readiness materialization fails before any provider call. The Worker sets the value to allocation.nextWorkId observed at its delivery commit, so all tasks registered earlier (including BB-084..095) are grandfathered.

D3 — scripts/blackboard-negative-case-binding.mjs exports assertNegativeCaseBindings(plan), testPassedInLog(log, title), extractTestBody(source, title) and checkBinding({binding, log, testSource}). No I/O inside; callers pass strings.

D4 — testPassedInLog accepts Node spec reporter lines (optional indentation, '✔ ' + title, optional ' (Nms)') and TAP lines ('ok N - ' + title). Any '✖ ' + title or 'not ok N - ' + title, a missing title, or a duplicate title fails. Titles are matched exactly after trimming, never as substrings.

D5 — extractTestBody locates exactly one test(…)/it(…) call whose first string argument (single, double or template quote, no interpolation) equals the title, then returns the balanced-parenthesis call text using a small tokenizer that skips string, template and comment content. Zero or multiple matches fail.

D6 — checkBinding requires the extracted body to contain an invocation of subjectSymbol (identifier or member call followed by '(' or used as `new`), and rejects bodies containing always-true assertion patterns: `|| true)`, `assert.ok(true`, `assert(true`, `assert.equal(1, 1`, or zero assert/expect calls.

D7 — collectEvidence: after verification runs, for each binding read the bound log and the testRef at candidateSha via git show, run checkBinding, and fail evidence collection with `negative case unbound: <id>: <reason>` on any failure. Passing bindings are appended to the implementation result as claims.negativeCases [{id, logRef, testRef, bodyHash}] (IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT allowed-keys unchanged: stored inside claims entries of the owning criterion).

D8 — Worker materialize adds state.negativeCaseEvidence [{id, negativeCase, criterionId, testRef, testTitle, subjectSymbol, body}] and one question per binding id: 'The executed test <title> establishes negative case: <text> against <subjectSymbol>'. Readiness materialize adds one question 'readiness-negativeCaseBindings' when bindings are present.

D9 — Regression reproduction: the test suite loads the real BB-064 foundation test from git at e6be04593fa00c55b59d55dc4dc3c8d2821f5930 and a binding whose subjectSymbol is createOracleContextResolver; checkBinding must fail with SUBJECT_NOT_INVOKED. The BB-064 plan's 8 failureMatrix classes bound to the single fail-closed test must fail coverage (one test title bound to many indexes is allowed only with distinct titles per index).

D10 — Evidence basis: executed gate-gap probe shows the fail-closed test never calls the facade, has 2 assertions for 8 classes, collectEvidence binds whole logs, and Jev passed FAIL_CLOSED at SATISFIED 0.51 vs INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE 0.46.
implementationSlices: N1 — Pure binding module [NB1, NB2]: create scripts/blackboard-negative-case-binding.mjs (D1, D3-D6). Tests titled "NB1 ..." cover coverage gaps/duplicates, unknown criterion/verification, testRef outside expectedTests, unsafe subjectSymbol and threshold on/off; tests titled "NB2 ..." cover spec pass, TAP pass, ✖/not ok, missing, duplicate, substring-only titles, extraction with quotes/templates/comments, subject not invoked and each vacuous pattern.

N2 — Plan schema + policy [NB1]: call assertNegativeCaseBindings from assertPlan when negativeCaseBindings is present; add negativeCaseBindingsFromWorkId (initially null) to jev-policy.json and enforce D2 in materialize before any provider call. An "NB1 repository plans still validate" test loads every current plan under docs/blackboard/artifacts/ready-implement-plan and asserts assertPlan passes unchanged.

N3 — Evidence collection [NB2]: extend collectEvidence per D7 using the existing fixture(t) temp-repository pattern from test/blackboard-jev.test.mjs (copied into the new file, not edited): an "NB2 collect ..." case with an unbound or failing negative must throw negative case unbound, and a bound passing case must record {id, logRef, testRef, bodyHash} in its criterion claim.

N4 — Atomic Worker judgment [NB3]: extend materialize per D8; "NB3 ..." tests with mock transport assert one question id per binding containing the extracted body, a readiness-negativeCaseBindings question when bindings exist, and verdict() output unchanged for identical answers.

N5 — BB-064 reproduction + wiring + docs [NB4]: "NB4 ..." tests load test/oracle-context-intelligence-foundation.test.mjs via git show e6be04593fa00c55b59d55dc4dc3c8d2821f5930 and assert SUBJECT_NOT_INVOKED for createOracleContextResolver and coverage failure for eight indexes bound to one title; assert git diff shows no docs/blackboard/artifacts change. Extend package.json test:blackboard-jev to include the new file, set the policy threshold to allocation.nextWorkId at delivery, document in docs/blackboard/contracts.md, docs/blackboard/jev.md and docs/living/system/state.md, then run verify:blackboard-context and npm run verify.

negativeVerificationCases: A plan at or above the threshold with negative cases but no negativeCaseBindings fails readiness materialization before any provider call.
A binding set that leaves a negativeVerificationCases index uncovered or covers one twice fails assertPlan.
A binding whose testRef is not in sourceSeams.expectedTests, or whose verificationId does not map to its criterionId, fails assertPlan.
A bound title absent from its verification log, marked failed (spec ✖ or TAP not ok), or appearing twice fails evidence collection.
A title that only appears as a substring of another test title does not satisfy the binding.
A bound test body that does not invoke subjectSymbol fails SUBJECT_NOT_INVOKED; the real BB-064 fail-closed test bound to createOracleContextResolver reproduces this.
A bound test body containing `|| true)`, `assert.ok(true` or no assertions fails VACUOUS_ASSERTION.
Plans below the threshold or without the field (all current DONE/READY plans) continue to validate and publish unchanged.
Any write under docs/blackboard/artifacts/**, docs/blackboard/evidence/** or packages/** fails repository scope verification.
A verification run whose name pattern selects zero tests must fail (node --test exits non-zero on no matching tests is not assumed; the NB suite asserts each prefix has at least one test).
